units.title: Human figure proportions and stylization
topics: 1.2. Comparative analysis of Male, Female and children ideal proportions
1.3. Preparing a personalized fashion croquis for Men’s wear, women’s wear and children’s wear range development
1.4. The croquies made should be used for further exercises in the course.
uos: 1.a. Draw actual human figures(from life) Male/female/children
1.b. Explain the eight headed human proportion
1.c. Draw and explain the elongated fashion figure: showing examples of fashion illustrator’s work, elongating the figure to 12+ headed proportions.

topics: 2.1. Identifying and Incorporating the element of ‘point’ in garments
2.2. Identifying and incorporating the element of ‘line’ in the design of garments

2.4. Identifying and incorporating the element of ‘colour’ in the design of garments

2.b. Apply basic elements of design in clothing.

units.title: Application of principles of designs in clothing
topics: 3.1. Repetition and the elements as applied to the clothing
3.2. Gradation and the elements in the clothing
3.3. Transition and the elements in the clothing
3.4. Radiation and the elements in the clothing
3.5. Rhythm and the elements in the clothing
3.6. Emphasis and the elements in the clothing

3.b. Apply basic principles of design in clothing.

units.title: Application of principles of designs in clothing to modify the look of the garment
topics: 4.1. Exploring the concept of large top slim bottom; slim top large bottom.
4.2. Creating an angular/sharp look through Colour, Line, Point and texture
4.3. Creating a Tubular/flat look through Colour, Line, Point and texture
4.4. Creating a Curvy look through Colour, Line, Point and texture
4.5. Accentuating various zones of the body through Colour, Line, Point and texture
uos: 4.a. Describe meaning of volume, colour, texture of the garment
4.b. Explain importance of volume, colour, texture of the garment and how it can alter and accentuate the appearance of the body shape.
